name: ST Testimonials Slider
author: subhamt411

sections.description:
ST Testimonials Slider is a sleek, responsive, and highly customizable plugin designed to display customer testimonials on your WordPress site. Boost your credibility and engagement by showcasing real feedback in an interactive slider.

Whether you’re building trust, highlighting success stories, or promoting customer satisfaction, this plugin offers an easy and elegant way to feature testimonials.

Features include:
– Responsive and mobile-friendly layout
– Customizable slider settings
– Add testimonial content, author, avatar, and more
– Lightweight and fast loading
– Shortcode integration for easy use in posts, pages, or widgets

Author

https://wordpress.org/plugins/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the st-testimonials-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [st_testimonials] to display the testimonial slider.
  4. Customize testimonial entries and settings from the WordPress admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I add a new testimonial?

You can add testimonials from the ST Testimonials section in the WordPress admin dashboard.

How do I display the slider on a page or post?

Use the shortcode [st_testimonials] where you want the slider to appear.

Is the slider responsive?

Yes, ST Testimonials Slider is fully responsive and works on all device sizes.

Can I customize the slider’s appearance?

Yes, you can adjust styles using custom CSS or theme overrides. Additional customization options may be available in plugin settings.
